In Hindu culture, the name is often given to a child born in auspicious circumstances, signifying that the child has been blessed by the gods. It is a name that carries a sense of optimism and good fortune.

It is believed that the child bearing this name is not just a human being but a divine being who is constantly graced by the presence of God. The name serves as a constant reminder for the individual to remain humble and devout, and to always strive towards spiritual growth and upliftment. It is a name that inspires faith and devotion towards the divine.
